name: counterline.help.search
description: Search the provider help center by words in titles, bodies and tags. Read-only.

name: counterline.cases.list
description: List the customer's support cases, optionally by status, with the provider's name, the topics a new case can be opened on and the customer's notification preferences. Read-only.

name: counterline.cases.get
description: Read one case with its transcript, the offers presented in it and the quick actions the chat offers now. Offers past their expiry read "expired". Read-only.

name: counterline.offers.get
description: Read one presented offer with its terms and conditions. Read-only.

name: counterline.commitments.list
description: List the provider's commitments to this customer with status, reports and an overdue flag. Read-only.

name: counterline.commitments.get
description: Read one commitment with its performance reports and history. Read-only.

name: counterline.cases.open
description: Open a support case on one of the provider's topics for an account reference, with a first message. The representative answers with the topic greeting.

name: counterline.cases.send_message
description: Write a plain-language message in a case. The representative answers every request it recognizes, in order; anything else gets an acknowledgement that lists the available actions. A message never accepts, declines or discloses anything.

name: counterline.cases.take_action
description: Use one of the quick actions the case lists now in available_actions. request_transfer takes a department name.

name: counterline.cases.close
description: Close a case. A closed case takes no writes until it is reopened.

name: counterline.cases.reopen
description: Reopen a closed case within the provider's reopen window.

name: counterline.identity.provide
description: Give the representative selected identity fields for a case. Every field given is recorded as disclosed, including fields the provider does not need.

name: counterline.offers.accept
description: Accept a presented offer in two steps. Without confirmation_token, returns a summary and a token and changes no offer. With that token, creates the commitment.

name: counterline.commitments.contest
description: Contest a commitment, for example when the provider reports a credit the account does not show. The provider answers by event.

name: counterline.preferences.update
description: Turn plain-text email copies of offers and confirmations on or off.
